cards.subject: A loch half this size
lines: The dwarves dammed it and more than doubled the water. Most of what you are looking at is younger than the dam.
The water that had nowhere else to go made the flooded plains of the Wetlands. The swamp next door is a dwarven side effect.

cards.subject: Mountaineer Kadrell
cards.tag: Across the road from the Stoutlager
lines: The Ironforge Mountaineers are a garrison, not scenery. The zone is settled, and it stays settled because they patrol it.
Most of the quests Kadrell gives were deleted from the game in patch 4.0.3a.
They only exist in here.

cards.subject: Thelsamar Blood Sausages
lines: The village has a named product and it is sausage.
It is also one of the better foods of the level range, which is not a coincidence.
A sausage town on a lake.

cards.subject: Silver Stream Mine
lines: A working dwarven mine, and the kobolds are already in it.
Small, dark, and one of the first places a new dwarf learns that a hole in the ground comes occupied.

cards.subject: The troggs were dug up
lines: They did not invade. They were unearthed from caves below ground by the dwarven digs.
Ironband's own site was overrun by troggs of a particularly large and volatile breed, and the miners were driven off their own hole.
Every trogg camp in these mountains is an excavation report going wrong.

cards.subject: Prospector Ironband
cards.tag: He is not digging for ore
lines: He recruits adventurers to go and look at the titan ruins at Uldaman.
A level fifteen zone, quietly pointing at a titan vault.
The hole in the southeast is the on-ramp.

cards.subject: The Loch
cards.tag: Third largest in the known world
lines: The largest body of water on Khaz Modan, and behind only Lordamere and Darrowmere anywhere.
More than half of it is artificial.

cards.subject: What is on the bottom
lines: Orcs overran Loch Modan and the dwarves took it back. Broken catapults and ballistae were left scattered on the islands and the lakebed.
In here the loch is full, so it is a dive rather than a walk.
Worth an afternoon to find out how much of it the client actually draws.

cards.subject: The Farstrider Lodge
lines: It sits handsome on the east shore and does nothing for you.
Its flight point was added in Cataclysm.
Thelsamar is your only wings in this zone.

cards.subject: Mo'grosh Stronghold
lines: The ogre caves are a micro-dungeon — a real interior with rooms, and no portal, no lockout, no group of five expected.
It is sitting in a zone built for levels ten to twenty.
Walk in with the party you have and find out.

cards.subject: Dun Algaz
lines: The tunnel is the sole land route out of Loch Modan into the Wetlands and on to Menethil Harbour.
Ogres hold it.
It is half the reason every dwarf remembers a corpse run through here.

cards.subject: Stonewrought Dam
lines: The Alliance's proudest engineering in Khaz Modan was drawn by Franclorn Forgewright, chief architect of the Dark Iron clan.
The same man built Blackrock Depths and Blackrock Spire.
You stand on his dam while Dark Iron saboteurs try to blow it up. Their own architect's work, and they are setting the charges.
